name: Serena
source: Serena is the senior student that helped you understand how things work at Arlington Academy on your first day of school. She is weirdly knowledgeable in many things regarding the school’s rules, to the point where you wonder if she is really a student... Serena and her friends are always there to assist you if you need any help!
